title: OpenAIRE Graph — datasource
cite_as: Manghi, P. et al. OpenAIRE Research Graph Dump (v3.0), Zenodo, 2021. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4707307
description: The **datasource** slice of the 2021 OpenAIRE Graph: 94,700 data sources (journals, institutional, thematic and data repositories, aggregators) as one range-queryable graph.
- One `oaire:Datasource` per record, with official and English name, type (`Journal`, `Institutional Repository`, `Data Repository`…), OpenAIRE compatibility level and website.
- Ids sit under `https://w3id.org/rete/openaire/10/…`, the ids the result shards' provenance and hosting relations point at.

Source: the **OpenAIRE Research Graph Dump v3.0** (Zenodo [10.5281/zenodo.4707307](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4707307), published 2021-04-27, CC BY 4.0), converted to Parquet on 2026-07-15 with `scripts/openaire/tars_to_parquet.py` (19 source tars matched by name and size, zero bad lines), then to N-Triples by `scripts/openaire/parquet_to_nt.py --only datasource`. Vocabulary `oaire:` = <https://w3id.org/rete/openaire#>.

Rebuilt with `rete build - --strict --memory-budget-mb 1500 --no-pyramid`. `--strict` refuses any IRI the N-Triples grammar or RFC 3987 rejects, so every IRI here loads into a strict triple store as-is. Website URLs (`websiteurl`) are percent-escaped where escaping keeps their meaning, and **dropped and counted** when they carry no scheme (`journal.unj.ac.id/…`, `www.ijrpsonline.com`) or are not a URL at all (a journal title, a number, an embargo note).
The converter prints its tally on every run. It never adds a scheme to a value that does not state one, and it never rewrites a host.
